title: OpenAI一夜甩出722篇数学论文！黎曼霍奇BSD全上阵，数学家：读不过来
raw_excerpt: 三位菲尔兹奖得主：不代表认可
summary: OpenAI 一次性公开了由内部前沿模型生成的 722 篇数学手稿，覆盖 372 个结果族，涉及黎曼猜想、霍奇猜想、BSD 猜想等长期未解问题，并同步在 GitHub 发布 Lean 形式化证明。三位菲尔兹奖得主表示这不代表学界认可。这是 AI 首次成规模产出原创数学成果，既展示推理能力跃升，也引发研究伦理与学术规范的激烈争论。

title: Mistral Large 4
summary: Mistral 发布 Mistral Large 4（代号 Le Chonk），在 Hacker News 上以 1756 分登顶当日热榜。作为欧洲最具代表性的大模型厂商，Mistral 此次更新被视为对 OpenAI、Anthropic 的直接回应。开源权重与欧洲主权 AI 定位是其差异化卖点，具体基准与定价细节见官方文档。

title: Reflection Introduces Beam Model
raw_excerpt: Beam is a 501B-parameter sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 23B active parameters trained for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads. The model used 23.8T pretraining tokens and more than 100M reinforcement-learning rollouts, with open weights and developer artifacts planned for release later in October.
summary: Reflection AI 发布 Beam 模型：501B 参数稀疏 MoE，激活参数 23B，使用 23.8T 预训练 token 和超过 1 亿次强化学习 rollout，专为编码、推理与智能体任务训练。官方计划 10 月晚些时候开放权重与开发者工件。这是又一家以开源权重挑战闭源前沿模型的重量级玩家。

title: EmbeddingGemma 2: an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
summary: Google DeepMind 发布 EmbeddingGemma 2，一款开放、轻量的多模态嵌入模型，延续 Gemma 系列的开源路线。嵌入模型是 RAG、检索与语义搜索的基础设施，多模态能力意味着可统一处理文本与图像向量。对自建检索管线的开发者而言，这是可直接替换闭源嵌入 API 的实用选项。

title: Google is about to remove free access to Gemini Flash and Pro
raw_excerpt: Starting on October 9th, anyone using Google Gemini on a free plan will be limited to the Flash Lite model . Free users can currently choose from Gemini Flash Lite, Flash, and Pro, but now you'll need a $4.99/month Google AI Plus subscription to access the standard Flash model. However, that subscription is also getting a downgrade - it will soon no longer include Gemini Pro. Google says AI Plus subscribers will receive an email letting them know when they'll lose access to it. After these changes, access to the top-tier Gemini Pro model and a "Deep Think" advanced reasoning option will be restricted to users with a Google AI Pro or Ultra s … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: Google 宣布自 10 月 9 日起，Gemini 免费用户将只能使用 Flash Lite 模型，标准 Flash 需订阅 4.99 美元/月的 Google AI Plus；同时 AI Plus 订阅也将失去 Gemini Pro 访问权。这是 Google 对 Gemini 免费额度的显著收紧，反映前沿模型推理成本压力，也意味着免费用户与付费用户的能力差距进一步拉大。

title: OpenAI in $30 Billion Round Talks With UAE Funds, BlackRock
raw_excerpt: OpenAI is in talks with multiple investment funds from the United Arab Emirates to help anchor a $30 billion round of financing. The UAE funds have discussed forming a syndicate to invest as much as $10 billion in the round. The University of California's endowment fund, BlackRock, Thrive Capital, and Andreessen Horowitz may also participate in the round alongside that syndicate. The fundraise is ongoing, and the details could change.
summary: 据彭博报道，OpenAI 正与多家阿联酋投资基金洽谈，为其 300 亿美元新一轮融资寻找锚定投资者，阿联酋基金拟组建财团投入至多 100 亿美元。加州大学捐赠基金、BlackRock、Thrive Capital 与 a16z 也可能参与。若成行，这将是 AI 史上最大规模单轮融资之一，凸显中东资本在全球 AI 竞赛中的分量。

title: Weight-loss drugs show signs of slowing biological aging, say drugmakers
raw_excerpt: Popular weight-loss drugs may do more than help people shed pounds. They might also melt away the years. Drug giants Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk say patients taking their drugs age less quickly, according to readouts from molecular “aging clocks.” Such clocks assess a person’s biological age by looking at changes to DNA that accumulate with time, or, in newer versions, by tracking levels of key proteins. Both companies found that overweight or diabetic patients taking the drugs, called GLP-1s, had reduced biological age compared to those taking a placebo, although the difference varied widely, depending on which type of clock was used, and what organ was tested. Overall, the difference was around “two to three years,” according to Nikolaj Roed, a global project leader at Novo, who says the company has been seeing “improved biological age in our patients across trials and across different tissues.” The findings add to wide speculation among scientists that GLP-1 drugs, as they are known, are acting on basic causes of aging and might be a true longevity treatment. “Two years is a pretty strong effect, in my book,” says Steve Horvath, a professor at the University of California, Los Angeles, who’s credited with inventing aging clocks . Horvath says the emerging data could provide “evidence that these GLP-1 drugs are actually what is known as geroprotectors, medications that slow or possibly even reverse biologic aging.” The companies shared their findings over the weekend during…
summary: 礼来与诺和诺德称，服用 GLP-1 类减肥药的超重或糖尿病患者，其分子「衰老时钟」读数显示生物年龄增长放缓，与安慰剂组存在差异但幅度不一。这是药企首次用衰老时钟指标评估减肥药的抗衰潜力。若被独立研究证实，将把 GLP-1 的市场叙事从减重扩展到延缓衰老，影响深远。

title: South Korea says AI agents appear to have been used to hack the country's banks
summary: 韩国总统李在明表示，AI 智能体似乎被用于攻击韩国多家银行。这是国家级层面首次公开将银行系统入侵归因于 AI 智能体，标志着网络攻击进入自动化、规模化新阶段。对金融行业而言，传统基于人工节奏的异常检测与风控模型可能失效，防御方需要重新评估智能体驱动的攻击面。

title: Announcing d1 with vision
raw_excerpt: d1, a decision model from Liquid AI, now supports images, text, or both as inputs. The model costs 19x to 200x less than GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5 and answers significantly faster on every task. It outputs probabilities for yes/no, choice, or score questions in one forward pass without generating tokens. Text decisions are made in 200 to 300 milliseconds.
summary: Liquid AI 发布决策模型 d1 的视觉版本，支持图像、文本或两者混合输入。该模型不生成 token，而是在单次前向传播中直接输出是/否、选项或评分的概率，文本决策延迟仅 200-300 毫秒，成本比 GPT-6.1 Sol 与 Claude Opus 5.5 低 19 至 200 倍。为分类、路由、审核等高频决策场景提供了极低成本方案。

title: Decisions API is in public beta
summary: OpenAI 在开发者平台上线 Decisions API 公开测试版，让开发者以结构化方式调用模型做决策判断。结合同日 Liquid AI 的 d1 决策模型，可见「不生成 token、直接输出决策」正成为一类独立 API 形态。对需要大规模、低成本、低延迟判断的应用（如审核、路由、风控）意义明显。
